title: Allow users to remove their profile photo (avatar) and persist removal

requirements.text: Add support for removing a user’s profile photo (avatar) from the Profile page by providing a clear UI action (e.g., “Remove Photo”) that, when confirmed, updates the user profile so that `profileImage` becomes `null` and the UI immediately falls back to the default avatar fallback (initial letter).

quotes: Also add we can remove photos I mean profile photos

acceptanceCriteria: When a user has an existing profile photo, the Profile page shows a visible action to remove it while in edit mode (or otherwise clearly accessible).
When the user confirms removal, the frontend calls the existing profile update flow with `profileImage = null` and keeps the current bio unchanged unless the user edits it.
After successful removal, the Profile page no longer renders an `AvatarImage` for the user and shows the fallback initial instead.
After a normal page reload and/or logout + login, the profile photo remains removed (still fallback initial).
Any temporary local preview URL and selected file state are cleared when removal succeeds or when the user cancels editing.

requirements.text: Ensure the backend persists profile photo removal: when updating the caller profile, a `null`/`none` `profileImage` value must clear the stored profile image for that user, and all profile reads (`getCallerUserProfile`/`getUserProfile`) must return `profileImage = null` afterward.

quotes: Also add we can remove photos I mean profile photos

acceptanceCriteria: Calling the backend profile update method with `profileImage = null` clears the stored profile image for that caller.
Subsequent calls to fetch the caller’s profile return `profileImage = null`.

No other profile fields (name, coins, nameChangeCount, finishedSetup, bio) are altered as a side effect of removing the profile image (except any explicitly updated fields included in the same request).

requirements.text: Ensure the authenticated header/avatar UI correctly reflects profile photo removal by re-rendering the fallback avatar when `profileImage` is `null` and by updating promptly after the remove-photo action completes (via existing React Query invalidation of `currentUserProfile`).

quotes: Also add we can remove photos I mean profile photos

acceptanceCriteria: After removing the profile photo, the Header avatar no longer shows the old image and instead shows the fallback avatar without requiring a hard refresh.
The Header continues to display the profile image when `profileImage` is present, unchanged from current behavior.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit files under the frontend immutablePaths list (e.g., useActor/useInternetIdentity/main entrypoints).
nonGoals: Do not add removal for background images or note attachments; this change applies only to the user profile photo/avatar.
Do not introduce third-party image hosting or external databases; persist removal using existing backend storage/profile mechanisms.
